text:
Maya K: Quick sync — we're targeting a public announcement for Adaptive Routing (hosted inference routing) on Mar 25 at 9:00am PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs URL, canary timing, and a short benchmark blurb for the blog. Also want webinar landing page + inbound lead routing sorted. @Jon P @Sophie L can you confirm?

Jon P: Docs PR merged to main: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing. Canary plan: start Mar 25 8:30am PT in us-west-2 at 10% traffic, ramp to 50% at 9:15am, full at 10:00am. We'll publish a deploy note to #eng-oncall when it starts.

Sophie L: Changelog draft is here: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/blob/main/2026-03-25-adaptive-routing.md — still waiting on final benchmark numbers from infra to lock the blog copy. Webinar landing page (draft): https://marketing.redwood.ai/webinars/adaptive-routing — needs copy & CTA. Sales inbound routing: I'm happy to own enterprise demo routing, just need the webhook schema from eng.

Tom R: Quick bench update: we ran long-context workloads on p4d and hit our target. Gist with numbers: https://gist.github.com/tom/abcd. Note: we're not including the quantized variant in the initial canary; we'll add it after initial validation. Also KV cache warming causes some cold-start spikes — call that out in docs.

Maya K: Awesome. Marketing will use the staging docs + changelog link. Can you give me a 2–3 sentence benchmark blurb I can paste into the blog and social copy by EOD?

Jon P: Draft blurb: "Adaptive Routing reduces median token latency by ~22% and lowers infra cost by ~18% on common chat workloads by routing short requests to cached pools and long requests to high-throughput instances." I'll post an alternate phrasing in ~45m.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout 1768804800 initiated by @jonp — status: queued.

Tom R: Posted detailed numbers in the gist: median 27ms -> 21ms, p95 450ms -> 360ms, cost/unit 1.00 -> 0.82. Also added a note about KV cache warming and recommended doc snippet.

Maya K: Great — I'll add the KV cache note to the staging docs. For inbound leads: Sophie will handle enterprise demos. Sophie — can you set up the Zapier webhook? We'll need the event fields so eng can emit them.

Sophie L: Yep, I'll set it up. Need the event schema + sample payload. @Jon P can you paste the event fields?

Jon P: Event schema (fields only):
```
customer_email
org_name
tier
trial_requested
region
feature_flags
```
I'll DM the webhook URL and sample payload to Sophie.

Maya K: Final ask — confirm rollback procedure if canary shows elevated errors. Is there an automatic fallback to the previous routing? @Tom R

Tom R: Yes — we have an automatic rollback trigger: if error rate >25% for 5 consecutive minutes we revert traffic to previous routing. Manual abort available in the console as well. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-rollback.

Maya K: Perfect. Marketing will schedule the blog post for Mar 25 9:15am PT (short delay to let canary warm), social at 9:30am PT, and webinar Apr 2 at 10am PT. I'll ping this thread with final copy. :rocket:

Jon P: I'll follow up once the deploy note is live.

Sophie L: I'll handle the Zap and confirm when the webhook is wired.

Tom R: I'll monitor canary metrics and post updates in #eng-oncall.
